settings.heading: Materials & Care
settings.tagline: Helpful guidance for reading product details, caring for toys and shopping with confidence. Always follow the information on each product page and packaging.

settings.heading: Look for clear product details
settings.body:
Where available, product pages may include age guidance, materials, dimensions and care notes. We only show information provided for that product — we do not invent certifications or safety claims.

If a detail is missing, check the packaging on arrival or contact us for help before purchase when possible.

settings.title: Check age guidance
settings.description: Use the age information shown on the product when it is provided.

settings.title: Review materials
settings.description: Materials and care notes appear when supplied for that product.

settings.title: Supervise play
settings.description: Follow packaging guidance and supervise little ones during play.

settings.title: Ask for help
settings.description: Contact us if you need clarity before choosing a gift or toy.
